I5.quote: We report the preparation of sucrose-based nanoporous carbons via template-assisted routes using zeolite USY as the hard-template.

notes: Original research article (Colloids Surf. A 444 (2014) 240-245). H2 uptake measured gravimetrically (Hiden IGA-001, buoyancy-corrected) at 77 K, 1 and 20 bar, for seven sucrose-derived carbons (UCs-60 to UCs-100, UCs-90-2, Cs-90); Table 1 gives BET areas for all. Zeolite template removed by HF/HCl; the USY zeolite itself has a BET area but no H2 uptake ('–' in Table 1). Cs-90 was made without zeolite. No retraction notice, no statement that the uptake values were published before; record.json is_retracted false. I5 quote is the first sentence of the abstract; the highlights and graphical abstract precede it on p. 1 and are also English. Table 1 checked against page image main-4.png.
